simple.meaning: צָרַע (tsâraʻ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to scourge , i.e. (intransitive and figurative) to be stricken with leprosy.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 20 times in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, and 1 more, beginning at Exodus 4:6. The surrounding contexts include Torah, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָרַע (H6879) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.

definitions.short: to scourge , i.e. (intransitive and figurative) to be stricken with leprosy
definitions.full: H6879. tsara [ צָרַע ] verb denominative , only in passive, be struck with leprosy, leprous ; — Qal Participle passive צָרוּעַ אִישׁ Lev 13:44 ; elsewhere as substantive, = leper , 13:45 ; 14:3 ; Num 5:2 (all P), Lev 22:4 (H). Pu`al Participle מְצֹרָע 2Sam 3:29 +, מְצוֺרָע 2Chr 26:20 ; plural מְצֹרָעִים 2Kin 7:3 , 8 ; feminine מְצֹרַ֫עַת Exod 4:6 +, מְצֹרָ֑עַת Num 12:10 ; — leprous , of hand Exod 4:6 (J), of person Num 12:10 (twice in verse) (E), 2Kin 5:27 ; 2Chr 26:20 ; מְצֹרָעִים אֲנָשִׁים 2Kin 7:3 ; as substantive = leper 2Sam 3:29 ; 2Kin 5:1 , 11 ; 7:8 ; 15:5 2Chr 26:21 a, 26:21 b, 26:23 ; הַמְּצֹרָע תּוֺרַת Lev 14:2 .
